title: It’s only fair when I think it’s fair: How Gender Bias Alignment Undermines Distributive Fairness in Human-AI Collaboration
reasoning: The paper focuses on distributive fairness and fairness perceptions, which are fundamental ethical concepts. It evaluates how human-AI teams achieve fair outcomes and how humans perceive the 'fairness' of AI systems, centering its entire study on ethics and moral judgment in algorithmic contexts.
